name: Marquetry
description: Veneer cut and fitted: an inner grid of diagonals, half of them removed.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: #000; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%); @even { clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }); mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: #000; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%); @even { clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
